I'll read both files completely before making my judgment.I have now read the entire section and the complete findings file (all 773 lines). Let me verify my analysis of the key concrete claims against the source findings.

I systematically checked every numerical/statistical claim, study result, location, and citation key. A representative sample of the verification:

- **Zhao2000** (Normania clay loam, MD 1.38 cm, R²=0.97; nitrate MD 2.16, R²=0.98; corn R²=0.69) → matches findings lines 392–394 ✓
- **Youssef2006** (MAE 11.8–13.5 cm, EF 0.70–0.76; drainage EF 0.64–0.67; monthly nitrate EF 0.48; cumulative −1.3 to 4.0%) → lines 412–416 ✓
- **Dar2022** (RMSE 8.88/9.66, PBIAS 15.41/19.52, NSE 0.53/0.47; NSE 0.82–0.84; 32.15/28.77 vs 33.07/26.88) → lines 472–474 ✓
- **Dar2025** (WTD 46.13/48.92, 53.53/55.42; RMSE 7.5/8.16; NO3 13.64/12.9, 11.09/11.19; NSE 0.66/0.70, 0.88; 1.3 m/42 m) → lines 11–15 ✓
- **Askar2025** (28.4 vs 27.6 cm; nitrate NSE 0.63; DRP NSE 0.63; TP val NSE −0.82, TP −19.2%; macropore ~4%) → lines 191–198 ✓
- **Negm2014/Negm2017/Singh2020b/Singh2022c** DRAINMOD-DSSAT figures → lines 131–134, 150–152, 168, 176–179 ✓
- **Ma2007/Ma2007b/Bakhsh2004/Ma2008** RZWQM figures (13.5 cm, 21.3 vs 17.6; EF 0.99/0.8; 7–16%; 348 vs 369, r²=0.94) → lines 233–234, 407–411, 448–453 ✓
- **Hu2007/Moriasi2012/Moriasi2013b/Boles2015/Bauwe2016/David2009/Hoang2017** SWAT figures → all matched ✓
- Cropping-system, ADAPT, ML/regression, and climate-change sections all matched (Wilson2020 28%/41%, Fang2012 ~40%, Moriasi2013 67%, Nangia2010c 45→22, Wang2021 14–16%/−11%, Li2025 Feb-peak/Apr-low) ✓

Citation keys consistently point to the correct source papers throughout. Grouped synthesis sentences (e.g., cold-season, temporal-aggregation, management-conclusion clusters) are supported by at least their cited members and represent legitimate review selection/framing.
